tree.heading: Delivery order contract.—
tree.text: The term “delivery order contract” means a contract for property that—

children.text: does not procure or specify a firm quantity of property (other than a minimum or maximum quantity); and
provides for the issuance of orders for the delivery of property during the period of the contract.

tree.heading: Task order contract.—
tree.text: The term “task order contract” means a contract for services that—

children.text: does not procure or specify a firm quantity of services (other than a minimum or maximum quantity); and
provides for the issuance of orders for the performance of tasks during the period of the contract.
